decisions.reason: The image count and retention clauses are independent changes already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the internal-link destination change does not alter image requirements.
Changing internal-link destinations does not alter the requirement to produce three blog articles.
The source does not change the publication destination or publication unit.
The word-count clause is an independent requirement already represented by its same-message INTRODUCE; it is not a consequence of the internal-link destination change.
The source specifies blog content changes but does not modify or remove the client-approval gate before publication.
Internal-link destinations do not change the AI-dolls blog's target audience.
The source does not add, remove, or replace any blog keyword target.
The internal-link destination change does not affect the website keyword count or replacement keyword.
The source contains no decision about including search-volume data.
Changing destinations for blog internal links does not change approved webpage replacement terms or their replacement scope.
The source does not affect H1 usage or website heading hierarchy.
The source does not change meta-title or meta-description optimization requirements.
